explanation: Methane burns completely in excess oxygen to form carbon dioxide and water, releasing a large amount of heat.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: Colourless methane gas at a burner jet, unlit.
beaker_view.final_appearance: No visible solid residue; water droplets condense on a cool surface held above the flame.

thermal.visual_cue: Burns with a clean blue flame, giving off heat and light.

beaker_view.observation: Methane burns with a clean, steady blue flame (not the sooty yellow a poorly-aired flame would give), and holding a cold, dry surface above it fogs up with condensing water droplets.
